app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on the UvA PhD pages; PhD applications go through individual vacancies.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the UvA PhD pages.

gre_general.value: The UvA PhD pages do not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: No central TOEFL minimum; a faculty or institute may set its own.

ielts_min.value: No central IELTS minimum; a faculty or institute may set its own.

english_waiver.value: No central rule on English-medium degrees; only 'a good command of English' is required and institutes may add requirements.

notes: UvA-wide PhD pages require 'a good command of English' and let a faculty or institute add language requirements; no test minimums or fees found.
